title: Jamaican Lentils Stew
description: A comforting, savory stew from the Caribbean, featuring brown lentils and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is low in calories and rich in protein and fiber.

ingredients.name: Kombu
ingredients.notes: cold-extract used in place of broth

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add thyme, allspice, and curry powder and cook for 1 minute, until spices are fragrant.
Add lentils, kombu-cold-extract, and tomato paste. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and continue to simmer for 10 minutes, until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
